title: Aquarius — Big Shifts This Week
youtube_description: Discover how Uranus reshapes Aquarius love and career this week. One astrologer breaks down the exact transits affecting romance and money, giving you actionable insight. Comment your sign for a personalized reading!

captions_structure.text: Get ready, Aquarius—Uranus is revving up fresh currents for this week. Monday and Tuesday glow as Mercury sextile Neptune in your 5th House, sparking love and vibrant art. Mars squares Saturn in your 1st House on Wednesday, demanding patience and testing resolve. Thursday brings Uranus conjoining your 10th House, sparking career breakthroughs and confidence. Friday’s Mercury trine Pluto in your 2nd House sharpens finances, urging savvy reinvestment. Saturday shines with Venus trine Jupiter in your 7th House, boosting relationships and social joy. Sunday’s Air element settles as Saturn sextile Mercury grounds long‑term goals, cementing career momentum. Tuesday shines for love as Mercury sextile Neptune lights your 5th House, perfect for romance. Wednesday tests you as Mars squares Saturn in your 1st House, so act with caution. Channel Tuesday’s love boost into a creative date that leverages the 5th House spark. Follow for daily updates.
